motion_system: hover pressure should feel like trapped weather escaping: seams widen, glints shear, and slit interiors brighten along the span
color_drift: charcoal and deep blue-black drift toward smoked brown and dull amber, with restrained E/F/D# green-violet glints and A#/C/C# pale-cyan sparks
glow_behavior: small edge glows gather only at punctures, bass-ridge apertures, and cut metal joints; no even neon wash
